name: Mars No.ε
source:
A mysterious first-generation Masei, who, together with [url=https://vndb.org/c43367]Uranus[/url], caused the Central's Slaughter. His physical prowess and all-consuming miasmas make him a very dangerous opponent. Despite it, Mars was defeated by [url=https://vndb.org/c42842]Valzelide[/url]. Currently, he is considered dead ever since.

[spoiler]Originally, "Carnage" was a young man called Daniel von Valentine, born in the old aristocratic Valentine family, with a defect that made him have strong impulses for killing.

Despite popular belief, Mars did not die after his defeat by [url=https://vndb.org/c42842]Valzelide[/url] but was instead taken to the secret Astral research facility in the depths of Central, where he was once "reborn."[/spoiler]
